$Comment: The Headless Horseman's hard ride: the same fight as Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Encounter, a
Variant of this pack's Orbis_Boss_Encounter_Template, with his hard forms and faster timings, the
way the game's own Gobliterator has a hard script beside its normal one. It runs in his hard
graveyard (Prefabs/Hallows_Eve/Hallows_Eve_Graveyard_Hard.prefab.json), where he rises from
Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Hard_Marker once the four Jack Skeletons guarding the fountain are
dead, the same GuardWave as the normal ride (the same creature; the hard graveyard's Mob Scaling
band makes them tougher).
What is harder lives in three places. His _HM roles carry more health (2376 against 1100, his
Head 450 against 300), the Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Hard_Mode effect, which makes everything he
swings or throws hit 40% harder, and in the saddle a lantern bomb he aims at a player for 3
seconds before he throws it, the one bomb of the fight thrown straight at someone. His health
steps are the _Hard_Scale effects, 1080 per player beyond the first. And _ForwardedModifiers
below tightens the phases: a volley every 4 seconds from the start, each bomb leaving a fire
patch; he is thrown at 54.55% (1296 of 2376 solo, so the saddle holds 1080 of it); his head
first flies 6 seconds after his fall, then every 28 seconds, and returns after 20; his wrath,
at 30% (713 solo) and only once his head has flown, brings burning volleys every 6 seconds.
No health packs fall on this ride. The bar shows the game's hard-mode style (BossBarHardMode)
and his hard name.
A win pays its own two Claims, Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Daily_Hard and Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase_Hard,
counted apart from the normal fight's, so a player can collect both on the same day. The binding
row ZiggfreedCommon/Encounters/Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Encounter_Hard.json names the fight
and keeps its records apart. This file's name is not a role's: a script named after a role
replaces it.
